```{python}
response = deepseek_client.chat.completions.create(model = "deepseek-v4-flash", messages = messages)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

#### Trying the scapper in the lecture 

```{python}
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root_dir = Path().resolve().parent
print(root_dir)
sys.path.append(str(root_dir))
from llm_engineering.week1.scraper import fetch_website_contents 
ed =  fetch_website_contents("https://edwarddonner.com")
print(ed)

```


```{python}
# Define our system prompt - you can experiment with this later, changing the last sentence to 'Respond in markdown in Spanish."

system_prompt = """
You are a helpful assistant that analyzes the contents of a website,
and provides a short and concise summary, ignoring text that might be navigation related.
Respond in markdown. Do not wrap the markdown in a code block - respond just with the markdown.
"""


```


```{python}
# Define our user prompt

user_prompt_prefix = """
Here are the contents of a website.
Provide a short summary of this website.
If it includes news or announcements, then summarize these too.

"""

```


```{python}
[
    {"role": "system", "content": "system message goes here"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "user message goes here"}
]

```


Depending on which description to you provide for the conent of the role, the system might give different responses. 
i.e. for yo ure a snarkly assistant, it will give you snarky response. 

```{python}
message = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "What is 2 + 2?"}
]

response = deepseek.chat.completions.create(model = "deepseek-v4-flash", messages = message)
response.choices[0].message.content

```



```{python}
def message_for(website):
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt_prefix + website}
    ]

```



```{python}

message_for(ed)

```

```{python}
def summarize(url):
    website = fetch_website_contents(url)
    response = deepseek.chat.completions.create(
        model = "deepseek-v4-flash",
        messages = message_for(website)
    )
    return response.choices[0].message.content


```


```{python}
summarize("https://edwarddonner.com")

```

```{python}
def display_summary(url):
    summary = summarize(url)
    display(Markdown(summary))
```


```{python}
display_summary("https://edwarddonner.com")
```

```{python}

display_summary("https://cnn.com")

```

